---
name: Feature or board port
about: Propose an improvement or support for another ESP32 board
---

## What would this make possible?
Describe the use case or problem.

## Proposed approach
Explain the change. For a board port, link the board's documentation and list
its display, touch, IMU, audio hardware and pin mapping.

## Validation
What hardware can you test on? Can part of this be checked with a host test?
